title: Quad9 exits France after DNS filtering ruling
summary: Quad9 has withdrawn its DNS service from France following a court ruling on DNS filtering, according to a Cloudflare blog post. The post treats the exit as a test case for internet fragmentation and privacy, raising concerns that resolver-level blocking obligations can push DNS providers out of national markets. The available account does not detail the ruling&\#x27;s specific blocking requirements or the exact scope of the French action.
